article.title: Timed Up-and-Go as a predictor of fracture risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis in a population of over 1.6 million people.
article.authors: Hernandez-Martínez J, Cid-Calfucura I, Vásquez-Carrasco E
article.abstract: This systematic review aimed to synthesize evidence from prospective cohort studies assessing the Timed Up-and-Go (TUG) test as association of fracture risk in older people, and to quantify the association through meta-analysis using hazard ratios (HR).
